name: matrix-spinner
description: A matrix-style scrambling spinner for Claude Code with a gleam, a live readout and an ephemeral verb the model can set after a long think, ported from the spinner in charmbracelet/mods.

longThinkSeconds.title: Long think (seconds)
longThinkSeconds.description: A single stretch of thinking this long lets the model pick one fresh verb for the rest of the turn. 0 turns it off.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colours for a dark or a light terminal. auto follows Claude Code's own theme (read only) and uses dark when it cannot tell.
